art_direction: 电青高马尾女性在洋红与钴蓝街景中大步回望，白色短袖上衣配深蓝短裤，发束划出鲜明斜线。
composition_variation: A beautiful 26-year-old original anime woman with a long electric-cyan high ponytail, cobalt underlayers, bright sapphire almond eyes and a spirited confident grin. Outfit: opaque white short-sleeve waist-length sporty top, cobalt high-waisted loose mid-thigh shorts, white sneakers with coral accents. Capture a decisive fast walking stride across a stylized summer city plaza: one leg clearly advances, the other trails, her shoulders rotate as she looks back toward the viewer. Arms counter-swing naturally at different heights, one bent near her ribs and the other extended down beside her trailing hip. Ponytail streams in a diagonal arc. Clearly offset shoulder line, separated knees and real momentum. Use head-to-shin framing and a mildly tilted eye-level camera, face and both hands inside the central safe area. Blazing hot-magenta architecture, cobalt shadows, electric cyan hair and small acid-yellow sunlight accents. Crisp parallel motion strokes behind the hair emphasize speed. Upper quarter is a radiant magenta-to-coral sky. Razor-clean facial drawing, sparkling eyes, warm peach cheek light, cyan rim light and deep violet shadow edges. Athletic everyday confidence and a striking graphic silhouette.
